the
>same weapon: what happens?

The weapon is contested until the end of combat.

>2)I play Vast Wealth on a vamp. who's already equipped with a Leather
>jacket.
>In my minion phase that vamp. search the first piece of equipement in my
>library by VW, and it's another Leather jacket: what happens?

* If the equipment cannot be legally placed on the vampire, it is
burned without cost. [RTR]

>3)Vamp A equips with Leather jacket. Vamp B taps herself to take that
>Leather jacket: who's untapped at the end of turn?

A and B, by card text.

Messages.Author: Francois Villon
Messages.Body:
1)One of my minions is equipped with a unique weapon.
She enters combat with a Ravnos who plays Horrid Reality and equips with the
same weapon: what happens?

2)I play Vast Wealth on a vamp. who's already equipped with a Leather

jacket.
In my minion phase that vamp. search the first piece of equipement in my
library by VW, and it's another Leather jacket: what happens?

3)Vamp A equips with Leather jacket. Vamp B taps herself to take that

Leather jacket: who's untapped at the end of turn?

Thanx.
